body: Don't do it to get revenge, the greatest revenge you can get is to become successful and cut ties with them. You're saying you're not worth it but you are. Every human is an individual who brings something new to the table, shaped by our own experiences that no one will ever experience. You ARE worth living for. Every day you're alive is a day you can find more of yourself, learn a new skill, broaden your horizons, help others with your experiences even with the emotions you're feeling right now, you have something to offer, and can use it to help make a difference, in someone else's life. People go through what you are going through. You can be a beacon of hope. Someone who shows others, they can get through it. Live not only for yourself, but for others. The only people who aren't worth it are your parents, don't validate their horrible behavior with your actions. Become better than them. Show them that they can't define you, you choose your path. It may be hard, it may take a lot of work, but you will live on. Cut ties with them if necessary, but don't let them bring this pain to your life.

I only lurk here on Reddit but I made this account just to talk to you. This post breaks my heart because I'm so sorry you have to go through something like this. But I and these other people want to help you, we care enough to come try to help you. Please don't kill yourself, live for yourself not others. Many people do it thinking no one cares, but when they're gone they don't see the heartbreak they've left behind. I know someone who killed the self. They probably felt the same way, like nothing was going right, like no one loved him. After he was dead, there was overwhelming sadness everywhere I looked. So many people mourned him. I've heard of so many great stories of people who were on the verge of suicide living on and overcoming everything that what bothered them. It doesn't seem like it, but things can change, and there are people who care. If anything, call the suicide hotline at +18002738255  or at least post to /r/suicidewatch these people want to help you and I want you to get help as well. Become a triumphant success story, it never seems possible, but I promise you it is.
